## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `manage.py check`, `makemigrations --check` and `pytest` pass
- [ ] Behaviour changes are covered by a test, and a bug fix has a test that fails without it
- [ ] New settings are in `.env.example` and the README configuration table
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] No secrets, real personal data, real addresses, server paths or real job postings in the code, tests, screenshots or this description
